title: Plan: next candidate after source-resident topN hard-bound rejection
source_head_before_experiment: current docs-plan head after this artifact is committed

basis.reason: Raw source-resident topN does not reach 10 tok/s under current VRAM shape unless it can hold 12.75-17.0 GiB of up/down payload in addition to gate behavior.

next_design_options.name: intermediate top768 resident batched SOTA candidate
next_design_options.purpose: Potentially improve above 4.4 tok/s, not a 10 tok/s route.
next_design_options.required_precondition: Write a separate bound for TTFT, cpu_moe/VRAM tradeoff, kernel overhead, and expected eval_tok_s after gate-cache impact.

next_design_options.name: exact CPU fallback batching/microkernel bound
next_design_options.purpose: Reduce the 19.029s decode up/down fallback without requiring raw resident payload for thousands of experts.
next_design_options.required_precondition: Measure how much time is source/page fault versus arithmetic/thread scheduling in the current CPU fallback and prove an upper bound above the 4.4 SOTA gate.

next_design_options.name: compressed/shared resident representation
next_design_options.purpose: Fit a top3072+ equivalent hotset into available VRAM.
next_design_options.required_precondition: Show an exact or top1-stable representation with at least 4x effective footprint reduction and decode overhead under 1.642s. Generic zstd-like compression is already rejected.

immediate_next_step: Write and execute a hard-bound for exact CPU fallback batching/microkernel, because it is the only listed path that does not first require impossible VRAM expansion.

rules.correctness_gate_before_performance: fixed-text llama-results top1 must pass for any numerical or scheduling change that can alter outputs
rules.sota_promotion: If a compliant >4.4 tok/s result appears, immediately record full reproduction data, commit and push to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then reproduce from pushed source.
